phase_title: V4.8.2 Residual Failure Differential Attribution & Hypothesis Formation - Analysis-Design Amendment 003
mode: GOVERNANCE WRITE / CANDIDATE-LAYER ANALYSIS-DESIGN RECONCILIATION ONLY
amendment_note: This amendment is PROSPECTIVE: it supersedes Amendment 002 ONLY for all FUTURE governed V4.8.2 candidate-layer derivation (candidate evidence eligibility, candidate validity, candidate support, shortlist, candidate ranking, shared residual decision, next-hypothesis decision) after independent audit. It does NOT rewrite history: the original snapshot, Amendment 001 and Amendment 002 remain immutable and historically valid. No candidate-layer governed output currently exists, so this is forward derivation, not rewriting an accepted candidate result. This artifact is CREATED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT and is NOT effective for governed derivation until a separate independent audit authorizes it.

prior_design_references.supersession_scope: Amendment 003 supersedes Amendment 002 ONLY for future governed candidate-layer derivation after independent audit. Amendment 002 remains historically valid for everything it previously covered. No historical path count is rewritten.

DEFECT_A.description: The effective candidate generation rule requires a candidate to originate from a mechanically observed differential feature, but the term 'mechanically observed differential feature' has no frozen candidate evidence-entry gate.
DEFECT_A.preserved_candidate_formation_principle: a candidate hypothesis must originate from one or more mechanically observed differential features in the frozen feature inventory; intuition-only candidates are invalid
DEFECT_A.reconciliation: Frozen prospectively as candidate_origin_eligibility_rule inside the effective payload.

DEFECT_B.description: The original authoritative Master Protocol requires features used for candidate support to have MEASUREMENT_RELIABILITY = HIGH or DIRECT, and an untraceable feature observation cannot support SUPPORTED / STRONGLY_SUPPORTED. The preflight / effective payload did not explicitly preserve this complete support-entry contract.
DEFECT_B.reconciliation: Frozen prospectively as candidate_support_rules.supporting_feature_traceability_gate inside the effective payload.

DEFECT_C.description: Several Master support predicates (independent differential domain, strong/weaker differential domain, multiple internally consistent mechanical features, candidate compatibility with prior A/B/G, direct frozen evidence contradiction, relevant negative evidence, conceptually coherent, materially discriminate) are not mechanically operationalized; without a fail-closed contract they could be guessed.
DEFECT_C.reconciliation: Frozen prospectively as candidate_support_rules.support_classification_fail_closed_policy and candidate_support_rules.mechanical_support_clarifications inside the effective payload.

DEFECT_D.description: The original authoritative Master Protocol ranking order is 1.support level, 2.number of independent supporting domains, 3.consistency across md-009 and md-015, 4.compatibility with prior null interventions, 5.ability to discriminate competing mechanisms, 6.minimality of future diagnostic intervention, 7.lower confound risk. The immutable preflight snapshot instead captured 1.support level, 2.case coverage, 3.independent supporting-domain count, 4.DIRECT-reliability feature count, 5.tie. No prior authorization changed the Master ranking contract; this is a confirmed UNAUTHORIZED_PREFLIGHT_DESIGN_CAPTURE_DRIFT.
DEFECT_D.reconciliation: Frozen prospectively as candidate_ranking_rules (seven Master criteria) inside the effective payload.

authorized_semantic_changes.summary: Freeze the candidate-origin differential-evidence eligibility rule (three values available AND canonical(md004) differs from at least one residual case) and its equivalent effective six-pattern eligibility (ELIGIBLE: NONRESPONDER_SHARED, MD009_ONLY, MD015_ONLY, MIXED; INELIGIBLE: ALL_SAME, NOT_AVAILABLE).
authorized_semantic_changes.does: answers only whether a feature may serve as originating differential evidence

authorized_semantic_changes.summary: Freeze SUPPORTING_FEATURE_TRACEABILITY_REQUIRED = YES and SUPPORTING_FEATURE_ALLOWED_MEASUREMENT_RELIABILITY = [HIGH, DIRECT]; a feature with MEASUREMENT_RELIABILITY = NOT_ESTABLISHED is ineligible as supporting evidence for STRONGLY_SUPPORTED / SUPPORTED.

Freeze the fail-closed support-classification contract preserving the five Master levels exactly, the positive/non-positive support-level rules, and the NOT_ESTABLISHED fail-closed extension with mandatory reason codes.
Add only mechanically safe restatements and explicitly record the surfaces that remain NOT_MECHANICALLY_OPERATIONALIZED (which trigger fail-closed behavior rather than guessed semantics).
Restore the effective ranking order to the seven Master criteria and remove case coverage and DIRECT-reliability supporting-feature count as standalone ranking criteria.

Freeze the lexicographic comparator fail-closed operationalization; an ungoverned comparator required to distinguish remaining candidates stops ranking discrimination and yields TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS = NOT_UNIQUELY_ESTABLISHED.

feature_canonicalization_rules.string: exact frozen text; no normalization beyond the predeclared value itself
feature_canonicalization_rules.list: kept in frozen order unless the feature is defined as an unordered set (none in this schema); elementwise exact comparison
feature_canonicalization_rules.float: rounded to 4 decimals by the frozen extraction_rule before comparison
feature_canonicalization_rules.missing: NOT_AVAILABLE is never equal to any value, including another NOT_AVAILABLE, for pattern classification; a feature with any NOT_AVAILABLE case value is pattern NOT_AVAILABLE

similarity_rules.comparable_features: features where md-009 and md-015 are both not NOT_AVAILABLE
similarity_rules.interpretation_boundary: mechanical feature similarity only; does not imply same causal mechanism

responsive_difference_rules.shared_residual_features: features where md-009 and md-015 have equal available canonical values
responsive_difference_rules.denominator: shared residual features where md-004 value is available (not NOT_AVAILABLE)
responsive_difference_rules.differential_shared_features: denominator features where canonical(md004_value) != canonical(shared residual value)
responsive_difference_rules.interpretation_boundary: descriptive differential strength only; does not automatically support any mechanism

effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.shared_residual_rule: SHARED_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS = YES only if a candidate supports both md-009 and md-015 and is based on NONRESPONDER_SHARED differential evidence; NO if md-009 and md-015 require materially different candidate evidence; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.candidate_generation_rule: a candidate hypothesis must originate from one or more mechanically observed differential features in the frozen feature inventory; intuition-only candidates are invalid

candidate_origin_eligibility_rule.purpose: This gate only answers: may this feature serve as originating differential evidence? It does not generate a candidate.
candidate_origin_eligibility_rule.rule: A feature is eligible as candidate-originating differential evidence iff: (1) md-004, md-009 and md-015 values are all available; AND (2) canonical(md004) differs from at least one residual case: canonical(md004) != canonical(md009) OR canonical(md004) != canonical(md015)

candidate_support_rules.STRONGLY_SUPPORTED: >= 2 independent differential domains; each domain contains at least one traceable mechanically reliable feature; features consistently differentiate md-004 from BOTH md-009 and md-015; candidate is compatible with prior A/B/G results; no direct frozen evidence contradiction
candidate_support_rules.SUPPORTED: one strong differential domain with multiple internally consistent mechanical features, OR >= 2 weaker independent differential domains; and no direct contradiction from prior intervention results
candidate_support_rules.PLAUSIBLE_ONLY: conceptually coherent but frozen evidence does not materially discriminate it
candidate_support_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: frozen evidence directly contradicts candidate or prior intervention already provides relevant negative evidence
candidate_support_rules.forbidden: PLAUSIBLE_ONLY must not be promoted to NEXT_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS

supporting_feature_traceability_gate.note: A feature with MEASUREMENT_RELIABILITY = NOT_ESTABLISHED is ineligible as supporting evidence for STRONGLY_SUPPORTED and SUPPORTED; an untraceable feature observation cannot support SUPPORTED / STRONGLY_SUPPORTED.

support_classification_fail_closed_polic.POSITIVE_SUPPORT_LEVEL_RULE: STRONGLY_SUPPORTED or SUPPORTED may be emitted only when EVERY predicate required by that level: (1) has a governed mechanical operationalization; (2) has admissible traceable frozen inputs; (3) mechanically evaluates as satisfied. An undefined predicate must never be guessed.
support_classification_fail_closed_polic.NON_POSITIVE_SUPPORT_LEVEL_RULE: NOT_SUPPORTED and PLAUSIBLE_ONLY may be emitted only when their own required predicates are mechanically operationalized and mechanically satisfied. PLAUSIBLE_ONLY must not be used as a generic fallback.
support_classification_fail_closed_polic.FAIL_CLOSED_EMISSION_RULE: Every valid candidate must emit exactly ONE of the five Master support levels.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_FAIL_CLOSED_EXTENSION.trigger: If none of the other four levels can be mechanically and uniquely established because: (A) admissible evidence is insufficient; OR (B) one or more required classification predicates lack a governed mechanical operationalization; OR (C) multiple mutually incompatible support labels would otherwise remain mechanically unresolved; then emit NOT_ESTABLISHED.
NOT_ESTABLISHED_FAIL_CLOSED_EXTENSION.GOVERNANCE_PREDICATE_NOT_OPERATIONALIZED: means only that the current governed contract cannot mechanically classify the candidate more strongly; it does NOT mean the candidate is scientifically disproven, the evidence is scientifically absent, or the mechanism is not supported in reality

support_classification_fail_closed_polic.AMBIGUOUS_NON_NOT_ESTABLISHED_RESOLUTION: If more than one non-NOT_ESTABLISHED level would be mechanically true and the effective design does not provide a governed precedence, fail closed to NOT_ESTABLISHED with NOT_ESTABLISHED_REASON = SUPPORT_LABEL_NOT_UNIQUELY_ESTABLISHED.

features_consistently_differentiate_md00.mechanical_representation: all three values available AND canonical(md004) != canonical(md009) AND canonical(md004) != canonical(md015)

mechanical_support_clarifications.not_mechanically_operationalized_behavio: These surfaces trigger fail-closed behavior rather than guessed semantics unless a definition already exists mechanically in governed authority.

candidate_ranking_rules.eligible: only STRONGLY_SUPPORTED and SUPPORTED candidates enter the ranked shortlist
candidate_ranking_rules.support_level_comparator: STRONGLY_SUPPORTED > SUPPORTED (preserved for the two shortlist-eligible support levels)
candidate_ranking_rules.ranking_evaluation: Ranking is lexicographic in the Master order. At each criterion: if the criterion has a governed mechanical comparator, evaluate it; if tied, continue to the next Master criterion; if the criterion does NOT have a governed mechanical comparator and a comparison is required to distinguish remaining candidates, STOP ranking discrimination and set TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS = NOT_UNIQUELY_ESTABLISHED.
candidate_ranking_rules.tie_rule: if still tied: TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS = NOT_UNIQUELY_ESTABLISHED (manual tie-breaking is forbidden)
candidate_ranking_rules.removed_criteria_rationale: case coverage and DIRECT-reliability supporting-feature count were captured by the immutable preflight snapshot but are not authentic Master Protocol ranking criteria (UNAUTHORIZED_PREFLIGHT_DESIGN_CAPTURE_DRIFT). They must not remain ranking criteria merely because the snapshot captured them. They remain usable only if independently required elsewhere for support evidence.
candidate_ranking_rules.other_comparator_semantics: All other comparator semantics must fail closed unless already governed.

effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.previously_tested_hypothesis_rule: these must be tagged PREVIOUSLY_TESTED_OR_CONSTRAINED; any overlapping candidate must state what new factor is actually different, otherwise the candidate is invalid
effective_analysis_design_semantic_paylo.next_hypothesis_rule: NEXT_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS is emitted only when TOP_CANDIDATE_SUPPORT is SUPPORTED or STRONGLY_SUPPORTED AND TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS is uniquely established; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED with NEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_GOAL = DISCRIMINATE_TOP_CANDIDATES

effective_differential_pattern_rules.NONRESPONDER_SHARED: canonical(md009) == canonical(md015) AND canonical(md004) != canonical(md009) AND all three available
effective_differential_pattern_rules.ALL_SAME: canonical(md004) == canonical(md009) == canonical(md015) AND all three available
effective_differential_pattern_rules.MD009_ONLY: canonical(md009) != canonical(md004) AND canonical(md009) != canonical(md015) AND canonical(md004) == canonical(md015)
effective_differential_pattern_rules.MD015_ONLY: canonical(md015) != canonical(md004) AND canonical(md015) != canonical(md009) AND canonical(md004) == canonical(md009)
effective_differential_pattern_rules.NOT_AVAILABLE: at least one case value is NOT_AVAILABLE

semantic_diff_firewall.diff_method: mechanical recursive key-by-key comparison of the two effective payloads

recomputation_requirement.note: After Amendment 003 passes independent audit, only future candidate-layer derivation must use the new effective design. No candidate-layer governed output currently exists, so this is forward derivation, not rewriting an accepted candidate result.

authorized_path_expansion.note: This eight-path effective set is PROSPECTIVE and applies only after Amendment 003 passes independent audit. It is NOT claimed to have existed historically; the original snapshot retains its 5-path authorization, Amendment 001 retains 6, and Amendment 002 retains 7. Amendment 003 adds exactly one new path.

digests.canonical_json_contract: json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) encoded utf-8 -> sha256; identical to the frozen project helper scripts/analyze_v4_8_generation_mechanism.py::canonical_json_digest and scripts/analyze_v4_8_2_residual_differential.py::canonical_json_digest (no private algorithm introduced).
digests.payload_version_note: The payload_version field inside the semantic payload is intentionally kept identical to Amendment 001 / Amendment 002 (v4_8_2_effective_analysis_design_semantic_payload_v1) so that the effective semantic payload differs from Amendment 002 only on the authorized candidate-layer reconciliation surfaces. A v3 marker is recorded only as amendment-level governance metadata, NOT inside the governed semantic payload.
